title: Chinese Academy of Social Science psychic abilities laboratory

tellings.quote: as soon as I showed up the first thing she did is she brought me to the laboratory showing me all these experiments they were doing with psychic abilities and they were exploring and trying to figure out what what all this was

plain: A man named Dan Sheehan says that on a visit to Beijing in the 1990s, a woman named Jen Jo Jing took him straight to a laboratory at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, a Chinese state research body. There, he says, she showed him all the experiments they were running on psychic abilities as they tried to work out what it all was. Sheehan tells it as something he saw himself, and if true it would mean China's government was studying psychic powers.
